paragraphs: Auror sells a retail crime intelligence platform to retailers and law enforcement agencies, built to bring crime intelligence together across a network of both. Retailers capture events in the platform, connect the dots between stores and cases, and identify potential threats.

Auror Core comprises five modules: Intel for incident reporting, Connect the Dots for AI-assisted person of interest matching with human verification, Investigate for case management, Insights for analytics and Audit for compliance workflows. Reported incidents build into in-depth profiles of the people and vehicles affecting an organization. Investigators then use that intel to build, collaborate on and resolve cases. A Risk Detection add-on extends this to prevention, with automatic alerts when known vehicles of interest enter a location. For law enforcement, the Retail Crime Hub, designed by Auror and Axon, moves packaged evidence from retailers straight into Axon Evidence for intake.

Auror puts its network at more than 85,000 stores and more than 3,500 law enforcement agencies, with a decade of accumulated intelligence across them. Auror says Cosentino's Food Stores achieved a 346% return on investment and a reduction of more than 90% in reporting time with the platform. The company has set itself the goal of reducing retail crime by 50% over the next five years.

quote.text: Unlike traditional case management tools, simplify incident reporting and enable secure collaboration between stores, retailers, and law enforcement, turning incidents into patterns, and patterns into outcomes.
